title: watch.event
description: One incident event emitted by perception. One JSON object per line (JSONL). This is the ONLY interface between the perception lane and everything downstream. Architect-owned: no lane edits this file.

type.description: The three incident classes the evidence supports. Nothing else is in scope for round 1.

room.description: Free-form room label from the camera's configured location, e.g. 'bedroom', 'kitchen', 'front_door'.

ts.description: UTC, RFC3339, Z-suffixed. NOTE: the board clock is wrong and has no NTP (reads April 2026). Perception must stamp from a corrected source or record the offset; a lane that cannot must report it as a finding.

confidence.description: Model confidence for this event. Downstream must not assume a threshold; thresholds live in the evidence lane.

discarded_frames.description: Frames processed on-device and destroyed without being stored or transmitted, since the last event. This is the privacy ledger primitive: it is the only number that makes 'nothing left the room' countable rather than asserted.
